threads.body: This major-version bump makes the scenario coverage contract stale: `scenarios/gen-ai/README.md:127` still says the `openllmetry` implementation is omitted because it does not support mistralai 2. Re-evaluate that implementation against v3 and either add it or update the documented reason for its omission.

replies.body: Rechecked OpenLLMetry against Mistral 3. Its current Mistral instrumentation still imports `mistralai.models` and wraps `mistralai.chat` and `mistralai.embeddings`, while Mistral 3 places these under `mistralai.client`. The implementation therefore remains incompatible. Updated the README in e041a4e2 to explain the omission using Mistral 3's client namespace.
